department: Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Biological and Biomedical Sciences (IGP)

deadline.value: Final deadline December 1 (priority deadline November 15 for early review and Graduate School supplemental awards).
deadline.quote: November 15 Priority Deadline for applications December 1 Deadline for applications

fee_waiver.value: Automatic waiver for anyone, including international applicants, who has done research on a US-funded project.
fee_waiver.quote: This waiver applies to US citizens, permanent residents, and international applicants.

funding.value: Full tuition, fees, health insurance and a stipend ($40,000 first-year in 2026-27).
funding.quote: Yes, the IGP offers full financial support and covers all tuition, fees, and student health insurance, including dental insurance and a yearly eye exam. In addition, students receive a stipend.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree or equivalent is required; no master's needed.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution in the United States or equivalent training at a foreign university is required.

notes: Umbrella first-year pathway into Biochemistry, Cancer Biology, Cell and Developmental Biology, Chemical and Physical Biology, Human Genetics, Microbe-Host Interactions, Pathology, Molecular Physiology and Biophysics, Pharmacology, and the Biological Sciences department. Quantitative and Chemical Biology is a separate application.
